instrument: City of North Port data center moratorium ordinance
summary: An 18-month moratorium advanced 4-1 on first reading. As drafted it would also freeze final approval of a pending 896,000 square foot data center application. The city attorney warned that blocking the pending application invites a legal challenge. Second and final reading was scheduled for September 22, 2026.
notes: Outcome of the final reading not confirmed. This is the clearest case in the register of a moratorium drafted to reach an application already in process.
confidence_note: Relayed; ordinance not read and final vote outcome unknown.
